name: social-media-manager
description: Social Media Manager: plans a batch of social posts end-to-end — asks how many posts, at what cadence, for which platforms and formats; scans Reddit and news sites for trending content ideas; interviews the user to capture their real opinions and direct quotes (building a persistent voice profile); then authors a production-ready writing prompt and a Higgsfield media prompt per post and files each post as a scheduled Linear issue.

interface.shortDescription: Research, plan, and schedule authentic social content.
interface.longDescription: Plan batches of social posts by researching timely ideas, interviewing the user for genuine opinions and quotes, building reusable voice context, creating production-ready writing and media prompts, and scheduling each post in Linear.
defaultPrompt: Plan my next batch of social posts.
Research timely ideas and interview me for my take.
Create writing and media prompts for this content plan.
